'''Danak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was part of Master [[Surro]]'s group of Jedi that served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] scouts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] after [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]]'s defeat at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. Danak was sent to gather information on the factory defenses, but was noticed by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Ivo (Balmorran)|Ivo]]. Ivo recognized Danak as a spy and, assuming him to be a member of [[Balmorran resistance]], decided to turn him in to the Empire. Ivo faked a leg injury and when Danak approached him to help, he was stunned and delivered to Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bowenn]], who executed him.
